description: This Java class, NetListMergeUtil, provides utility methods for reading, writing, and validating sections within text files, primarily used for merging network list configurations.

classes.name: NetListMergeUtil
classes.description: A utility class for handling file operations and validation logic related to network list merging.

methods.name: writeResult
methods.description: Writes the specified content into a file with the given filename, printing a message to the console.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a string, with a preliminary check for file existence.

methods.name: checkExistence
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists and is a file; terminates the program if not.

methods.name: validateSection
methods.description: Validates that parentheses within a section string are balanced and properly nested.
